text:
sam_finance: Customer SummitAI flagged an unexpected Dedicated overage on INV-2025-1219 for May 30. Can billing/eng take a look?

lee_billing: Invoice shows Dedicated commit May: $11,000; Overage 2025-05-30: $1,340. No SLA credit applied.

ara_eng: Looking at placement logs around 2025-05-30T09:12Z - small failover window (~48s) routed to Dedicated due to replica restart in eu-west-1. Requests included two long-context jobs that spiked tokens. IDs: s7, s8.

maya_cs: SummitAI insists they didn't change workload. They want a refund or credit.

sam_finance: If it's our replica restart and not customer-driven, Finance prefers full credit. Need incident link for audit and a reason code.

ara_eng: Filed INF-3199. Root cause: replica restart triggered by auto-restart policy during a flaky healthcheck. Patch: adjust healthcheck sensitivity and add short cooldown to avoid routing churn. Confirm provider fault.

lee_billing: Proposed adjustment ADJ-9784 = $1,340, reason code DED-REPLICA-FAILOVER. I'll wait for Finance approval then create the BIL ticket.

sam_finance: Approved. Please include INF-3199 and note "provider-initiated restart". Also flag SummitAI account so CS knows the credit is issued.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BIL-4620 - "ADJ-9784 for INV-2025-1219 (DED-REPLICA-FAILOVER)". Audit trail started.

maya_cs: I'll notify SummitAI with the credit and timeline, include BIL-4620. Thanks all.
